whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Verma's Kitchen,

I noticed your restaurant has a stellar 5.0★ rating in Kidwaipuri, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online food orders and table bookings.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp ordering, menu showcase, aur table reservation integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/vermaskitchen

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Verma's Kitchen team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Verma's Kitchen) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp food ordering and a digital menu showcase for Kidwaipuri customers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual prices aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
